author: KEXP
description: Oklahoma City-based band Chat Pile deliver a set of defiant noise rock in our latest Live on KEXP in-studio session. With host Troy Nelson, the four-piece share a charged performance of "Pen I S Mall" and more.
title: Chat Pile performs "Pen I S Mall" & more Live on KEXP
